notes:
REF-BM-02: Saving performs no page metadata fetch; title defaults to the URL, description and preview are absent, and favicon is only derived at display time.
REF-BM-03: Title and description are editable before and after saving, but no auto-collected values are available to edit.
REF-BM-04: URL, title, description, and tags are editable, but bookmark notes are unsupported.
REF-BM-06: Duplicate URLs are inserted as new rows with no detection or edit guidance.
REF-BM-10: Tag entry is a plain comma-separated text field with no autocomplete.
REF-BM-12: Search covers title, description, and URL but there is no note field to search.
REF-BM-14: The search parser does not implement #tag syntax.
REF-BM-15: Boolean operators, grouping, and operator-literal quoting are unsupported.
REF-BM-16: Quoted phrases receive no exact-match handling.
REF-BM-17: No unread/read-later state exists.
REF-BM-18: No unread-only view exists.
REF-BM-19: Bookmarks cannot be marked read.
REF-BM-20: There is no multi-selection or bulk-action mechanism.
REF-BM-21: There is no whole-filtered-collection bulk action.
REF-BM-22: Ordering is fixed in SQL; users cannot choose a sort key.
REF-BM-23: Notes and markdown rendering are unsupported.
REF-BM-24: No local HTML or PDF snapshot functionality exists.
REF-BM-25: No Internet Archive snapshot integration exists.
REF-BM-26: No archive state or default-list exclusion exists.
REF-BM-27: Only permanent deletion exists; reversible archiving does not.
REF-BM-28: No archived-only list exists.
REF-BM-29: Bundles and saved filter combinations are unsupported.
REF-BM-30: Netscape HTML import is unsupported.
REF-BM-31: Netscape HTML export is unsupported.
REF-BM-32: No personal display settings are implemented.
